# AdsCrawl Scrapers

Repository: https://github.com/AdsCrawl/adscrawl-scrapers
License: OSL-3.0; see NOTICE for upstream attribution.
Install from root: python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
Credentials: ADSCRAWL_API_KEY (never print or commit it).
Offline checks: python -m pytest tests -q; python scripts/check_catalog.py
Live tests: python -m pytest <site>-scraper/test.py -v (consumes credits).
Historical results are upstream examples, not verified AdsCrawl output.
Use adscrawl_scrapers.Request and ScraperClient for HTML, JSON and network data.
Remote traffic must go through the AdsCrawl SDK, never a local requests client.
Decorate async site operations with managed to close named remote sessions.
Unknown request options must raise errors. All sites need live verification.
